title: Asset Streaming, Cache, Memory Management & Device Recovery

gates.evidence: Manifest snapshot parser validates schema v1, rejects URL traversal, rejects unsupported meshopt extensions with typed ErrorCode::AssetUnsupportedExtension, and enforces SHA-256 and size integrity.
Instance-level generation tokens and AbortController cancel superseded fetch/load operations (A->B->A race test verified winning generation renders 38,605 triangles without corrupting scene state).

CacheStorage persistence (ADR-004) verifies SHA-256 via Web Crypto API. Warm reload performs 0 network requests; offline mode serves cached packages and yields typed recoverable NETWORK_ERROR for uncached misses; corrupted cache entries are automatically detected, purged, and re-fetched.

Atomic scene and GPU buffer swap preserves camera position/target/zoom, selected structure ID, and isolation/visibility states. 20x rapid LOD toggle confirmed all 26 TA2 structures intact and zero monotonic memory leak (initial peak: 3.27 MB, final: 3.21 MB).

simulateDeviceLoss triggers buffer teardown, context recreation, and automatic reload from verified local cache (26/26 nodes restored). Physical driver crash recovery marked NOT_RUN due to sandbox limitations.
Engine idle state verified: renderFrame() returns false when no user interaction or camera changes occur, avoiding continuous frame drawing and conserving battery.

Dual WASM bundles (pkg-webgpu and pkg-webgl2) validated in headless Chrome. All 35 workspace unit/adversarial cargo tests pass; baseline pelvis, Core PBR, Stage 6, Stage 7, and silhouette audit scripts pass with 0 errors.
commercial_release_allowed remains false; assets are restricted to local non-commercial research and validation under CC BY-SA 4.0; no public CDN or commercial distribution performed.
